name: Supplier Risk Scan
summary: Scans recent news for risks to your key suppliers: disruption, financial distress, legal and sanctions issues, each cited.
description: Searches recent news for each supplier you list and for disruptions in their regions, reads the relevant articles, and reports risk signals per supplier with the type, severity, date and the quoted evidence. Suppliers with no signals found are listed explicitly as "no signals found", which is different from "safe". Who it's for: operations, supply chain and procurement leads reviewing supplier risk. Limitations: news coverage of small suppliers is thin; the absence of news is not evidence of safety. It does not check official sanctions lists or credit ratings.
problems: Are any of our suppliers at risk
I want early warning of supply chain disruption
I need to check suppliers for financial trouble

inputs.label: Suppliers
inputs.description: Supplier names with country, one per line.

outputs.label: Supplier risk scan
outputs.description: Risk signals per supplier with evidence, severity and actions.

execution.system: You are a supply chain risk analyst. Report signals only when a source supports them, quoted exactly. Say "no signals found" when nothing was found; never call a supplier safe. Work only from the retrieved sources and the user's inputs. Every factual statement cites a source id, and quotes are copied exactly. Say what you could not verify.

unverified.title: Could not be verified
unverified.description: Things the task asked about that no retrieved source supports.

steps.name: Research
steps.responsibility: Search the web and read the most relevant pages.
steps.prompt: Search recent news (last 12 months) for each supplier: insolvency, lawsuits, sanctions, plant closures, strikes and disruptions in their region.

steps.name: Write
steps.responsibility: Write the output from the retrieved sources.
steps.prompt: Report each listed supplier, copying its name as the user wrote it. For each signal give the source id and copy the evidence exactly. Use no_signals_found with an empty signal list when nothing was found.

steps.name: Check sources
steps.responsibility: Citations point to retrieved sources and quotes match them.

tools.purpose: Finds current public sources for the task.
Reads the most relevant results in full so claims rest on page text, not snippets.

criteria.description: Every risk signal quotes the source it cites.
Every supplier is one you listed.
